title: Glessner's stable hoist stone and cupola ledges matched to their photographs
items: The hoist stone under the stable gable's arch now reaches about four feet out over 18th Street, a slim tapered stone cantilever as the 1887 photograph shows it; it had been a stubby block under two feet long.
The long dark streak beside it in the 1963 survey photograph turned out to be its shadow, so no timber beam was added.
The stone ledges round the rooftop cupola's pigeon holes now wrap its corners unbroken, as both northwest photographs show.
